issueSummary: The site has real local trust signals but buries them under generic Wix copy, vague CTAs, broad ungrouped services, and unfinished template leftovers.
topFindings: Generic hero CTA and service labels do not guide visitors toward calling for an estimate.
Unused Wix-style Blog/Book/Shop/Subscribe clutter and template language weaken trust.
Broad roofing, tree, remodeling, siding, fence and snow services need clearer buyer-intent grouping.
preservedDesign: Preserved the Wix-like stacked sections, dark header, top email/phone bar, Playfair-style serif headings, simple local-contractor tone, and broad-service positioning.
criticalCoverageStatus: All critical findings fixed or improved in the prototype: CTA clarified, template clutter removed, trust moved near top, and services reorganized.
